title: Chapter 1434
text:
In the white desert where the radiation storm was raging, a strong light suddenly flashed. An expedition starship emitting flames drilled out of the crack and fell as if it had lost its power. It crashed into the ground with a loud bang, causing white sand to fill the sky. The remaining momentum did not weaken as it rolled and plowed a deep ravine on the ground. Wherever it passed, a white dragon was raised.

The azure particle shield that was on the verge of shattering endured the impact and flickered a few times like a light bulb with bad contact. Then, it suddenly disappeared. The spaceship sank, and its head stabbed into the desert. Its tail was raised high, and the distorted propulsion nozzle flashed with electric sparks. With a sudden shake, it finally malfunctioned and spewed out black smoke.

Clang! Clang! Clang!

The cabin door of the spaceship was stuck, and there was a sound of impact coming from inside. The alloy door panel bulged out, and then it was sent flying with a bang. The deformed cabin door smashed into the sand and slid more than ten meters away.

Harrison and the others walked out while holding their injuries. Their bodies swayed as if they had drunk fake wine. The gravity stabilizing device and gyroscope of the spaceship malfunctioned, and everyone was dizzy from the fall.

One of the team members looked at the paralyzed spaceship and said in a panicked tone, "It's over. The spaceship has been destroyed. We can't escape!"

"Don't panic. The enemy didn't chase after us. Hurry up and repair it."

Harrison held his dizzy head and gritted his teeth as he ordered the panicked team members to repair the spaceship.

The outpost was attacked, and a large number of expedition teams fled in all directions. The Blessed Race of the World Tree chased after them non-stop, and they also encountered enemies. The team only had one last spaceship left, and it was not easy for them to shake off the pursuers. However, the spaceship that had endured the fierce attacks was overloaded to the limit and lay there.

"I wonder how the outpost is now?" a team member muttered to himself.

"It's definitely gone. The World Tree came prepared. With the armed forces of the outpost, it's impossible for it to survive."

"When we were escaping, the commander was still giving orders in the main control room. I'm afraid he has already sacrificed himself in the self-destruction and died with the base …"

A sorrowful atmosphere pervaded the crowd. After working together for more than ten years, many expeditionary army members were already familiar with each other. At this moment, so many of their comrades' futures were uncertain and their odds were stacked against them. Everyone was endlessly worried.

"The situation of the World Tree's attack should have been transmitted back to the main universe. Before I evacuated, I had already sent a message to His Excellency Black Star through the quantum network base station of the outpost. He should have received it, but he hasn't come to help yet. I don't know …"

Harrison's tone was hesitant. The moment he was attacked, he had sent a request for help. During the process of escaping, he had been protecting the 'throne' that Black Star had specially left for him. He had been waiting for Han Xiao to arrive, but there had been no response until now.

"Can we contact him again?" someone asked hurriedly.

"Not at the moment. There is no base station that can be connected to. We can't communicate with the outside world for the time being …"

Harrison was only halfway through his sentence when a spatial fluctuation suddenly appeared on the spaceship. Han Xiao, who had teleported over, walked out of the broken hatch. Everyone was pleasantly surprised to see him.

"Your Excellency Black Star! You're finally here! "

"We're saved!"

Han Xiao raised his hand and gestured for everyone to control their emotions. He then looked at Harrison and sized him up. "Looks like you're in good condition. You're not injured."

Harrison walked up with a disappointed expression and said, "You're late. The outpost has already fallen. They …"

Han Xiao interrupted him and nodded. "Alright, I already know about the situation. If the outpost is gone, so be it. The three Universal Civilizations have already arranged for people to pick up the other scattered expeditionary army soldiers. This time, I'm mainly here to pick you up … and your teammates."

Han Xiao had already received Harrison's request for help when he received the emergency notice from the three Universal Civilizations in the Siebert Base's operations room. The reason why he had only rushed over now was because he had taken the time to mobilize the high-level combatants of the association. He had even gone to the Realmless King's side to protect the Pivotal Snake and hide it in a secret place. After doing these important things, he came to pick up Harrison. Han Xiao was not afraid that something would happen to Harrison. He had been using the Observer's Mark to monitor Harrison's situation. Seeing that he was safe, he did not teleport over immediately.

"What about the outpost? Aren't you going to provide support? "Harrison asked.

"There's no need. The dimensional coordinates of the various outposts have been exposed, and it's not suitable to rebuild the base. Even if we want to rebuild the outpost, it will be somewhere else. The losses this time aren't too big. The outpost has already played its role over the years."

Han Xiao waved his hand.

The purpose of the outpost was only to facilitate the expeditionary army's exploration of the deeper secondary dimensions, and the coordinates of the various dimensions had long been recorded in the database. The coordinates of the Realmless King's territory and the surrounding area of the World Tree were already under the control of the three Universal Civilizations, which meant that these places had become 'new shallow dimensions'. Thanks to the special structure of the secondary dimension world, with the coordinates in hand, even if there were no outposts, the follow-up troops could quickly jump over. They did not have to travel for many years like normal exploration. This was the most important result.

As for the outpost itself, it did not have irreplaceable value. With these coordinates in hand, they could rebuild it at any time. Therefore, this loss was nothing in the eyes of the three Universal Civilizations. What they were more concerned about was the extent of the information leak.

Harrison nodded, and asked, "Then what are we going to do next?"

"I'll bring you to the base camp of the three Universal Civilizations in the secondary dimension world. They have already gathered their troops there and are preparing to deal with the possible attack of the World Tree … The coordinates might have been leaked this time, so the World Tree opening up the secondary dimension battlefront should be a foregone conclusion. Next, the three Universal Civilizations will have to face a two-front battle … After sending you off, I still have to have a short meeting with the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations to discuss this matter."

Han Xiao said casually. His tone was calm and not worried at all.

At this time, the World Tree was most likely still cleaning up the battlefield in the various outpost dimensions, but he had no intention of coming back. Even if he went over, the Secret Tree King might not appear. He might as well wait for the Secret Tree King to start fighting on two fronts while he waited for him to strike and give him his favorite slap. If the World Tree had the coordinates of the shallow dimension, it would not take long to jump over, and it would even be qualified to start another round of blitzkrieg. Therefore, Han Xiao estimated that the Secret Tree King would not take too long.

Han Xiao gave a simple explanation and did not say anything else. He raised his hand and summoned a new vehicle. After setting the destination coordinates, he called for everyone to board the ship and leave.

Everyone obediently accepted the arrangements. Compared to the other expeditionary army soldiers, this group of people was lucky enough to benefit from Harrison and receive Han Xiao's personal help. They quickly escaped danger.

…

The Galactic Alliance Army was divided into many armies. The Border Defense Army was responsible for guarding the frontlines of the Flickering World, while the secondary dimension garrison was responsible for guarding the base camp area in the shallow dimension. This was the foundation of the three Universal Civilizations in the secondary dimension world. If it was wiped out, they would lose most of their control over the secondary dimension.

A few hours after the outpost was attacked, all the war zones in the shallow dimension had already entered a state of combat readiness, and the garrison was ready for battle.

At this moment, in one of the shallow dimension war zones.

During the period when the blue energy was filled, the scene was like an ocean. A dynasty fleet that belonged to the secondary dimension garrison floated in midair, quietly waiting for orders. All the battleships were specialized in the secondary dimension. Compared to the dynasty's conventional heavy military starships, they were much longer and more proportionate.

"I've just received news that a battle has broken out at the frontlines of the Flickering World again. The World Tree Army has launched another attack. At this juncture, it's very likely that the enemy is using a two-pronged strategy. Therefore, the enemy will appear at any time. Everyone, stay alert!"

In the main ship, the commander spoke in the army channel.

The dynasty soldiers on the various ships were in high spirits and did not dare to be distracted.

After waiting for a while, the fleet commander suddenly received orders from the other troops. His eyes focused, and he shouted with a deep voice, "The World Tree Army has already attacked. Thirty-four war zones have already been invaded, and the other defending troops are exchanging fire. It will be here soon …"

As soon as he said that, the spatial wall suddenly opened, and beehive-like jumping points appeared one after another. The World Tree Blessed Race swarmed out like a green tide.

"Attack!"

The fleet commander roared.

Bang! Bang!

The next moment, countless energy beams lit up in the field, crisscrossing to form a dense net, shattering a large wave of battleships.

The two troops were not afraid at all. It was as if they had turned into two giant beasts, one black and one green, fiercely biting each other. They did not care about their own injuries and only cared about devouring each other's flesh.

The same scene happened in hundreds and thousands of shallow dimensional war zones. War erupted!

The war mode of the secondary dimensions was different from the main universe. Every war zone was a divided battlefield. With the help of the special 'geographical' structure, countless fleets shuttled through the various secondary dimensions while exchanging fire, carrying out restraints, pulling, encircling, and so on. The situation changed rapidly, and the flames of war swept through countless small worlds. Pieces of secondary dimensions were blasted into dregs, and the remains were swallowed by the space storm.

The high-level combatants of both sides also began to clash, and the battlefield moved from one dimension to another.

…

In a certain shallow dimensional war zone that was riddled with holes, a teleportation gate hung high in the sky, spitting out a few Beyond Grade As from the three Universal Civilizations, all of them injured. Not far away, a green teleportation gate opened, and more Holy Tree Emissaries chased after them.

The few Beyond Grade As did not care about recuperating and quickly turned around to fight. They were once again at a disadvantage, and the situation was even worse.

"Don't even think about leaving the secondary dimensions alive!"

Several Holy Tree Emissaries were filled with killing intent. Their attacks were ferocious, and their eyes flickered with joy.

In the past, when they fought with the Beyond Grade As of the three Universal Civilizations, due to the existence of that healing Esper, all the high-level combatants of the enemy were like suicide squads, causing them to suffer greatly. They could not feel the joy of the World Tree's infinite revival.

However, it was different now. In the secondary dimension battlefield, due to the special battlefield structure, that healing Esper would definitely be greatly restricted and could not take care of every battlefield … Furthermore, the healing Esper did not even have the time to come over. The main force of the main universe had launched an attack, dragging many of the enemy's high-level combatants to the frontlines. That healing Esper was among them.

Now that they saw how helpless the enemy was, the Holy Tree Emissaries finally felt happy.

At this moment, among the besieged Beyond Grade As, Austin was among them. Half of the magic treasures on his body had already exploded, and he resisted the attacks with difficulty. His face was tense and solemn.

"The situation isn't looking good. If we don't receive any reinforcements, we will definitely suffer losses."

Even with the Sanctum Revival, most people did not want to fall to such a state. There was only one Aurora, and everyone wanted to stay on the frontlines to fight alongside the healer. Therefore, there were very few high-level combatants who were willing to provide reinforcements in the shallow dimensions. Other than the direct descendants, none of the others were willing. They were all ordered to come and provide reinforcements. There was a huge difference in numbers between them and the enemy, and the situation was not looking good.

At the side, Beiger was fighting with a high-level Holy Tree Emissary. Hearing this, he said in a low voice, "Don't panic, we still have reinforcements."

"What reinforcements?" Austin frowned.

At this moment, the spatial wall far away from the battlefield suddenly opened, and an unmarked fleet broke into the battlefield. They directly fired a dense number of sharp missiles at the World Tree Blessed Race, which exploded when they hit the shield.

The next moment, the place where the missiles exploded turned into spatial turbulence, directly sweeping up a group of World Tree Blessed Race members and disappearing without a trace.

"This is …" Austin's pupils constricted.

"The Holy Covenant's Dimensional Exile Bullet," Beiger continued.

"Holy Covenant? What is that … "

Before Austin could ask, waves of Beyond Grade A fluctuations soared into the sky.

Boom!

A few unfamiliar Beyond Grade As flew out of this mysterious fleet and quickly approached, joining the battle and launching a fierce attack on the Holy Tree Emissary.

The pressure on Austin lessened, and he hurriedly retreated a distance. Watching the two sides fight, he was shocked.

"These are the reinforcements you were talking about? Who are they? "

"Don't you think they look familiar?" Beiger raised his brows.

Austin looked over, and his expression changed. He recognized a few people. They were all famous Primordial Ones in history.

When he thought about Beiger's identity, he suddenly realized something and became bewildered.

"They're all Revivors like you? I thought Black Star didn't revive them. When did this happen? "

"You'll know the details in the future. Now is not the time to talk about it."

Beiger did not explain further. He dodged the enemy's counterattack and pierced through the enemy's chest with a forbidden spell.

Austin's heart skipped a beat. He looked at them deeply and did not ask any more questions, rejoining the battle.

Similar scenes happened in many war zones. The dozens of Revivors who had been hiding in the Holy Covenant organization for many years finally participated in the battle for the first time. They assisted the Beyond Grade As of the various paths and quickly stabilized the situation of the high-level combatants.

Not only was the World Tree surprised by this wave of reinforcements, even the three Universal Civilizations' frontline army was confused. For a moment, they could not figure out the origins of this batch of reinforcements.

At the same time …

The leaders of the three Universal Civilizations who were monitoring the secondary dimension battle turned to look at Han Xiao, who was watching the battle together in the office. Their expressions were very subtle, mixed with shock, pain, and other complicated emotions.

"Black Star … aren't you going to explain?"
